summary.zh: 发版前扫描安全、数据库与依赖风险
summary.en: Scan security, database and dependency risks before you ship.

description.zh: 部署前对代码库做一次体检，覆盖安全、数据库、部署配置、依赖和可观测性，把关键问题标出来并拦住流程。适合发版前和上线评审时使用。扫描结果需要结合业务判断，不替代人工评审。
description.en: Runs a pre-deploy check across security, database, deploy config, dependencies and observability, then blocks the release on critical findings. Use it before a launch or a go-live review. Findings still need business judgment.
